entities.name: Romeo Montague
entities.description: 蒙太古家之子，因误信朱丽叶死讯而买毒药。

entities.name: Juliet Capulet
entities.description: 凯普莱特家之女，罗密欧的爱人，假死中。

entities.name: Friar Laurence
entities.description: 神父，曾答应给罗密欧送信。

entities.name: Balthasar
entities.description: 罗密欧的仆人，从维罗纳带来朱丽叶死讯。

entities.name: Apothecary
entities.description: 曼图亚的穷苦卖药人，卖给罗密欧毒药。

entities.name: Mantua
entities.description: 罗密欧流亡所在的城市，卖药人居住于此。

entities.name: Verona
entities.description: 鲍尔萨泽带来消息的城市。

entities.name: Capel's monument
entities.description: 朱丽叶被安葬的家族墓穴。

entities.name: poison
entities.description: 卖药人卖给罗密欧的致命毒药。

relations.subject: Romeo Montague
relations.evidence: How fares my Juliet? That I ask again; For nothing can be ill if she be well.

relations.subject: Juliet Capulet
relations.evidence: I dreamt my lady came and found me dead,— Strange dream, that gives a dead man leave to think!— And breath’d such life with kisses in my lips, That I reviv’d, and was an emperor.

relations.subject: Balthasar
relations.evidence: O pardon me for bringing these ill news, Since you did leave it for my office, sir.

relations.subject: Juliet Capulet
relations.evidence: Her body sleeps in Capel’s monument, And her immortal part with angels lives. I saw her laid low in her kindred’s vault,

relations.subject: Apothecary
relations.evidence: And hereabouts he dwells,—which late I noted In tatter’d weeds, with overwhelming brows, Culling of simples, meagre were his looks, Sharp misery had worn him to the bones;

relations.subject: Juliet Capulet
relations.evidence: Her body sleeps in Capel’s monument, And her immortal part with angels lives. I saw her laid low in her kindred’s vault,

relations.subject: Apothecary
relations.evidence: Such mortal drugs I have, but Mantua’s law Is death to any he that utters them.

relations.subject: Romeo Montague
relations.evidence: Come, cordial and not poison, go with me To Juliet’s grave, for there must I use thee.
